message: So, I was thinking about how often we hear the phrase "better safe than sorry"—and let me tell you, that really rings true when it comes to fire safety at home. I mean, who wants to be the one fumbling around looking for a fire extinguisher while everyone else is calmly evacuating? This resource from Ready.gov is packed with handy tips that make being prepared a lot less like a comedy of errors and more like a well-rehearsed plan. What’s your go-to fire safety tip?
